definitions.explanation: The newest model of a product such as a phone, car or appliance. Used as a noun or before another noun with の.

examples.japanese: {最新型|さいしんがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought the latest model of smartphone.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最新型|さいしんがた}だ。
examples.english: This car is the newest model.

examples.japanese: {最新型|さいしんがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧もの⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: The latest refrigerators cost far less in electricity than old ones.

notes:
Made of ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧ (newest) + ⟦{型|がた}→〜型：32450_gata⟧ (model, type; がた by rendaku).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最新型|さいしんがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: the latest model of ~
- {最新型|さいしんがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}える→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧: to replace something with the newest model

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧: newest — the general word, used for news, information and technology as well as products
- ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧: new type — a new model, not necessarily the newest; also in ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦コロナ→コロナ：28801_korona⟧ (the novel coronavirus)
- ⟦{旧型|きゅうがた}→旧型：18276_kyuugata⟧: old model
